Class HudLines

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.HudLines
public final class HudLines extends Object
Short lines of text shown under the coin counter in the corner of the screen. Any mod can add one, for example the slot machine's jackpot or the lottery's pot. 
HudLines.register("slotmachine.jackpot", player -> Message.translation("server.slotmachine.hud.jackpot").param("amount", "1,250"));
The function is asked again every few seconds; return null to show nothing for that player right now.
